mapper.select: SELECT count(DISTINCT ws.id) FROM workflow_step ws JOIN operator_version ov ON ov.id = ws.operator_version_id JOIN workflow_version wv ON wv.id = ws.workflow_version_id AND wv.deleted = false JOIN workflow w ON w.id = wv.workflow_id AND w.deleted = false WHERE ov.operator_id = #{operatorId} AND ov.deleted = false

SELECT w.workflow_id AS workflow_id, w.workflow_name AS workflow_name, wv.version_no AS version_no, wv.publish_status AS publish_status, ws.step_name AS step_name FROM workflow_step ws JOIN workflow_version wv ON wv.id = ws.workflow_version_id AND wv.deleted = false JOIN workflow w ON w.id = wv.workflow_id AND w.deleted = false WHERE ws.operator_version_id = #{versionId} ORDER BY w.workflow_id, wv.version_no, ws.step_name
mapper.update: UPDATE operator SET deleted = true, version = version + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = false
